items.title: Show HN: Say Toucan - my feedback board 3x'd its price, so I built my own (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: My user feedback board provider increased its price from $15 to $25 to $50/mo, so I built a ~free alternative that does just the few things I need: make a feature request, vote on feature requests from others. There's a paid tier at $2/mo, and I only need ~1% of users to opt-in to pay to offset server costs. Of course, you can request features on Say Toucan using Say Toucan: https://saytoucan.com/b/say-toucan (The name is so dumb and I'm so thrilled with myself. Say Toucan do it!) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49582948 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
